sentences.text: The petitioner seeks a direction for the respondent to issue a short validity passport.

The petitioner is facing charges in CC No.13117/2024 under Sections 420 and 465 of the IPC, among other criminal offenses, and the trial is currently pending before the IX Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate,
Bengaluru.

entities.text:
IX Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate,
Bengaluru
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: 2. The learned counsel for the respondent submits that the issue involved in this petition is addressed in the decision of the coordinate Bench of this Court in W.P. No.24269/2023 (Santhosh Beejadi Srinivasa vs. Union of India).

entities.text: Santhosh Beejadi Srinivasa vs. Union of India
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 3. Therefore, this petition is disposed of in accordance with the order passed in the aforementioned petition.
The petitioner is granted liberty to approach the jurisdictional Magistrate and file an application seeking permission to travel abroad.
If such an application is allowed by the jurisdictional Magistrate, the respondent shall consider the issuance of a short validity passport.
The jurisdictional Magistrate shall expedite the consideration of any such application filed.

opennyai_summary.facts:
The petitioner seeks a direction for the respondent to issue a short validity passport.
The petitioner is facing charges in CC No.13117/2024 under Sections 420 and 465 of the IPC, among other criminal offenses, and the trial is currently pending before the IX Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate,
Bengaluru.

opennyai_summary.decision:
3. Therefore, this petition is disposed of in accordance with the order passed in the aforementioned petition.
The petitioner is granted liberty to approach the jurisdictional Magistrate and file an application seeking permission to travel abroad.
If such an application is allowed by the jurisdictional Magistrate, the respondent shall consider the issuance of a short validity passport.
The jurisdictional Magistrate shall expedite the consideration of any such application filed.
